description: Ask a common homeowner plumbing question and get a short, plain-language, teach-first answer. Covered topics: running toilet / flapper dye test, finding the main shutoff and the 3 shutoffs, water meter leak check, gurgling drains, high water pressure signs and PRV, sediment / popping water heater, rotten-egg hot water smell, garbage disposal dos and don'ts. Off-topic questions get an honest list of what is covered.

question.description: The homeowner's question in plain words.

name: plumbing_question
